title: DLinear: A simple DLinear baseline matches or exceeds contemporary transformer forecasters on ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using DLinear, a decomposition linear baseline. On ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1, at horizon 336, A simple DLinear baseline matches or exceeds contemporary transformer forecasters on ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1. DLinear achieved lower average MSE than five transformer baselines across 8 datasets at horizon 336. We discuss two limitations: Attention weights are not analysed, leaving the interpretability claims unverified. Hyperparameters are tuned per-dataset, which advantages larger models that can absorb the added capacity.
